authored_by: Engineering Lead, first pass derived from existing rules fields
pending_review: Pending Head of Product review of every record; Product owns the final values
taxonomy_source: Head of Product specification, Status: Proposed
alignment: Source of truth: retirepilot/retirepilot_rules_v1.2.json. Also PSD v2.7 section 3 and Appendix A, and docs/APPROVED_DECISIONS_v2.7.md decisions 1A, 2A, 3A and 7A.
decision_1A: No risk tier. Labels are not suitability advice or product recommendations.
decision_2A: cpf_retirement_situation values describe patterns only. No amounts and no entitlement claims.
decision_3A: Labels are internal only. They must not appear in the consumer UI, API or exports until reviewed. All personas are retained. Matching gates, weights and results are unchanged.
decision_7A: evidence_level is None: internal design, no research. Favourable consumer testing is not assumed.
derivation_rule: First pass derived from existing gate, criteria predicates, name, family and planning_focus. Use varies or spans_stages rather than guessing an age band, work type, CPF situation or household context.
usage_restriction: Do not use these labels to infer a user's age, CPF status or any other attribute. Do not change matching gates, weights or results.

records.name: Lower-wage employee
records.planning_complexity_reason: Low income with high essential costs and low liquidity raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate employee; criteria income_low, essentials_high, liquid_low, cpf_contrib; planning_focus Essential expenses and CPF savings. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate employee maps to salaried; cpf_contrib indicates accumulating; no household predicate, so household_context is varies.

records.name: Middle-income salaried worker
records.planning_complexity_reason: Typical salaried household planning around housing and dependants.
records.rationale: Gate employee; criteria income_mid, children_dependent, mortgage_active, cpf_contrib; planning_focus Housing, family costs and retirement accumulation. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate employee maps to salaried; cpf_contrib indicates accumulating; children_dependent maps to dependants.

records.name: High-income executive
records.planning_complexity_reason: High income with lifestyle inflation and asset-growth goals raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate employee; criteria income_high, executive_role, investment_assets, retirement_goal; planning_focus Lifestyle inflation, asset growth and retirement target. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate employee maps to salaried; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies; no household predicate, so household_context is varies.

records.name: Dual-income professional household
records.planning_complexity_reason: Joint planning for a dual-earner household raises coordination difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate household_dual_earner; criteria employee, income_high_household, partner_earns, joint_goal; planning_focus Joint planning and income concentration. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; criteria employee maps to salaried; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies; household_dual_earner and partner_earns map to couple.

records.name: Single-income family provider
records.planning_complexity_reason: Household dependence on one salary raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate household_one_earner; criteria employee, children_dependent, partner_not_earning, high_dependency; planning_focus Dependency on one salary. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; criteria employee maps to salaried; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies; children_dependent and high_dependency map to dependants rather than couple.

records.name: Contract employee
records.planning_complexity_reason: Contract renewal uncertainty and contribution gaps raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate contract_work; criteria employee, short_contract, renewal_uncertain, income_variable; planning_focus Renewal uncertainty and contribution gaps. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; criteria employee and gate contract_work map to salaried; contribution gaps in the planning_focus are not a CPF pattern predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Retrenched professional
records.planning_complexity_reason: Income interruption after retrenchment raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate retrenchment_event; criteria previously_employee, income_interrupted, late_career, employment_transition; planning_focus Income interruption and revised retirement plan. late_career is not a tight age band, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate retrenchment_event with previously_employee and income_interrupted, and no new work predicate, maps to not_working; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Late-career employee
records.planning_complexity_reason: Working later than a typical retirement goal raises timing difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate employee; criteria age_60plus, working_beyond_65, retirement_goal_late, cpf_income; planning_focus Working beyond typical retirement expectations. age_60plus and working_beyond_65 span more than one life-stage band, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate employee maps to salaried; cpf_income may or may not mean payout has started while still working, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Ride-hail driver, CPF opted in
records.planning_complexity_reason: Platform earnings, vehicle costs and a CPF opt-in path raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate ridehail_platform; criteria platform_opted_in, platform_income, actual_vehicle_costs, cpf_platform; planning_focus Net earnings and increased CPF contributions. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate ridehail_platform maps to platform_gig; platform_opted_in and cpf_platform indicate accumulating; no household predicate, so household_context is varies.

records.name: Ride-hail driver, not opted in
records.planning_complexity_reason: Platform earnings without a CPF opt-in, using a MediSave path, raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate ridehail_platform; criteria platform_not_opted_in, platform_income, medisave_path, age_45plus; planning_focus MediSave and alternative retirement accumulation. age_45plus is open-ended rather than a single band, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate ridehail_platform maps to platform_gig; platform_not_opted_in and medisave_path map to limited_or_no_cpf as a pattern, not an entitlement.

records.name: Motorcycle delivery rider
records.planning_complexity_reason: Operating costs, injury exposure and earnings volatility raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate delivery_motorcycle; criteria platform_income, vehicle_costs, income_variable, physical_risk; planning_focus Operating costs, injury and earnings volatility. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate delivery_motorcycle maps to platform_gig; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Bicycle/walking delivery worker
records.planning_complexity_reason: Physically demanding platform work with irregular earnings raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate delivery_nonmotor; criteria platform_income, age_60plus, physical_work, income_variable; planning_focus Physical sustainability and irregular earnings. age_60plus spans more than one life-stage band, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate delivery_nonmotor maps to platform_gig; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Multi-platform worker
records.planning_complexity_reason: Consolidating income across platforms raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate multiple_platforms; criteria platform_income, two_platform_payers, income_variable, expense_streams; planning_focus Income consolidation across platforms. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate multiple_platforms maps to platform_gig; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Salaried worker with platform side income
records.planning_complexity_reason: Salary and platform side income follow separate contribution pathways.
records.rationale: Gate employee; criteria platform_side_income, salary_income, platform_income, separate_contribution; planning_focus Mixed statutory contribution pathways. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; salary_income plus platform_side_income maps to mixed; separate_contribution indicates accumulating; no household predicate, so household_context is varies.

records.name: Retrenched worker relying on gig income
records.planning_complexity_reason: Replacement gig earnings after retrenchment raise retirement-gap difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate retrenchment_event; criteria platform_income, income_interrupted, late_career, employment_transition; planning_focus Replacement earnings and retirement gaps. late_career is not a tight age band, so life_stage is spans_stages; current platform_income after retrenchment_event maps to platform_gig; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Older taxi/private-hire driver
records.planning_complexity_reason: Older platform driving with reduced hours and payouts raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate driver_taxi_phv; criteria age_65plus, parttime_work, cpf_income, income_variable; planning_focus Ageing, reduced working hours and payouts. Criteria age_65plus maps to payout_age_65_plus; gate driver_taxi_phv maps to platform_gig; age_65plus with cpf_income maps to payout_started as a pattern; no household predicate, so household_context is varies.

records.name: New property agent
records.planning_complexity_reason: Irregular commissions and thin cash reserves raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate property_agent; criteria new_to_trade, commission_income, income_variable, liquid_low; planning_focus Irregular commissions and cash reserves. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate property_agent and commission_income map to self_employed_or_commission; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Established high-income property agent
records.planning_complexity_reason: Multi-year commission volatility, tax and savings raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate property_agent; criteria established_trade, commission_income, income_high, commission_history; planning_focus Multi-year income volatility, tax and savings. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate property_agent and commission_income map to self_employed_or_commission; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Property agent with declining commissions
records.planning_complexity_reason: Declining commissions near a retirement goal raise timing difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate property_agent; criteria commission_decline, commission_history, income_variable, retirement_soon; planning_focus Reduced earnings and retirement timing. retirement_soon is not a tight age band, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate property_agent maps to self_employed_or_commission; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Insurance/financial advisory agent
records.planning_complexity_reason: Commission persistence and volatility raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate insurance_agent; criteria commission_income, renewal_commission, income_variable, trade_expenses; planning_focus Commission persistence and volatility. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate insurance_agent and commission_income map to self_employed_or_commission; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Freelance consultant or professional
records.planning_complexity_reason: Contract gaps and SEP MediSave contributions raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate freelance_professional; criteria contract_income, contract_gaps, sep_medisave, income_variable; planning_focus Contract gaps and SEP contributions. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate freelance_professional maps to self_employed_or_commission; sep_medisave maps to limited_or_no_cpf as a MediSave-only pattern, not an entitlement.

records.name: Hawker or sole proprietor
records.planning_complexity_reason: Business costs, thin liquidity and SEP MediSave raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate hawker_or_sole_prop; criteria business_income, operating_expenses, liquid_low, sep_medisave; planning_focus Business costs and retirement liquidity. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate hawker_or_sole_prop maps to self_employed_or_commission; sep_medisave maps to limited_or_no_cpf as a MediSave-only pattern, not an entitlement.

records.name: SME owner
records.planning_complexity_reason: Business equity, succession and exit planning suggest specialist review.
records.rationale: Gate sme_owner; criteria business_equity, business_exit_goal, illiquid_assets, succession_goal; planning_focus Business equity, succession and exit. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate sme_owner maps to self_employed_or_commission; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Multiple-income entrepreneur
records.planning_complexity_reason: Integrating business, rent and investment income raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate entrepreneur; criteria multiple_income_types, business_income, rental_income, investment_income; planning_focus Business, rent and investment income integration. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate entrepreneur and multiple_income_types map to self_employed_or_commission as the organising work pattern; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Married couple without children
records.planning_complexity_reason: Joint retirement objectives for a couple without children are a standard planning situation.
records.rationale: Gate married; criteria no_children, joint_goal, partner_assets, household_dual_earner; planning_focus Joint retirement objectives. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies; married household_dual_earner with no_children maps to couple.

records.name: Single never-married individual
records.planning_complexity_reason: Solo retirement and housing security for a single household is a standard planning situation.
records.rationale: Gate never_married; criteria single_household, no_children, housing_independent, solo_goal; planning_focus Solo retirement and housing security. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies; single_household and never_married map to single.

records.name: Parents with dependent children
records.planning_complexity_reason: Education and household obligations for parents with children are a standard planning situation.
records.rationale: Gate children_dependent; criteria household_with_children, education_expenses, mortgage_active, retirement_goal; planning_focus Education and household financial obligations. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies; household_with_children maps to dependants.

records.name: Single parent
records.planning_complexity_reason: Childcare, protection and savings in a one-parent household raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate single_parent; criteria children_dependent, one_parent_household, education_expenses, income_protection; planning_focus Childcare, financial protection and savings. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; children_dependent and one_parent_household map to dependants rather than single, because child obligations organise the pattern.

records.name: Sandwich-generation caregiver
records.planning_complexity_reason: Supporting children and an ageing parent at the same time raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate children_dependent; criteria parent_supported, education_expenses, care_expenses, high_dependency; planning_focus Children plus ageing-parent financial support. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; parent_supported and care_expenses map to caregiver rather than dependants, because sandwiched care organises the pattern.

records.name: Non-working spouse
records.planning_complexity_reason: Individual retirement adequacy with spousal income dependence raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate individual_not_earning; criteria married, partner_earns, personal_cpf_low, income_dependence; planning_focus Individual retirement adequacy and spousal dependence. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate individual_not_earning maps to not_working; personal_cpf_low maps to limited_or_no_cpf as a pattern, not an entitlement; married and partner_earns map to couple.

records.name: Multigenerational household
records.planning_complexity_reason: Shared expenses and cross-generation support raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate multigenerational_household; criteria shared_housing, parent_supported, children_dependent, shared_expenses; planning_focus Shared expenses and cross-generation support. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; gate multigenerational_household maps to multi_generation.

records.name: Parent supporting adult children
records.planning_complexity_reason: Continued transfers to adult children raise retirement affordability difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate adult_child_supported; criteria parent_of_adult, family_transfers, high_dependency, retirement_goal; planning_focus Continued family transfers and retirement affordability. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; adult_child_supported and parent_of_adult map to dependants.

records.name: Recently divorced parent
records.planning_complexity_reason: Asset division, housing transition and child obligations after divorce suggest specialist review.
records.rationale: Gate divorce_event; criteria children_dependent, asset_division, housing_transition, child_support; planning_focus Asset division, housing and child obligations. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; children_dependent and child_support map to dependants.

records.name: Divorced pre-retiree
records.planning_complexity_reason: CPF and capital after a divorce settlement near retirement suggest specialist review.
records.rationale: Gate divorced_status; criteria age_55plus, cpf_settlement, asset_division, retirement_soon; planning_focus CPF and retirement capital after settlement. Name 'Divorced pre-retiree' plus age_55plus and retirement_soon map to near_retirement_55_64, but age_55plus is open-ended so this needs Head of Product review; work type is not stated, so work_income_type is not_applicable; cpf_settlement is not a tight CPF-retirement pattern, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies; post-divorce household context is not stated, so household_context is varies.

records.name: Widowed working adult
records.planning_complexity_reason: Lost household income, estate proceeds and insurance claims after widowhood suggest specialist review.
records.rationale: Gate widowhood_event; criteria was_employed_household, income_interrupted, estate_receipt, insurance_claim; planning_focus Lost household income and estate proceeds. No age-band predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages; the name says working adult but no work-type predicate is present, so work_income_type is not_applicable; no CPF-retirement or current household-structure predicate, so those fields vary.

records.name: Widowed retiree
records.planning_complexity_reason: Survivor income and revised spending after widowhood in retirement raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate widowed_status; criteria retired_status, survivor_income, estate_assets, living_alone; planning_focus Survivor income and revised spending. retired_status without an age-band predicate is not enough to choose a life-stage band, so life_stage is spans_stages; retired_status maps to not_working; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies; living_alone maps to single.

records.name: Remarried blended family
records.planning_complexity_reason: Blended-family dependants and beneficiary planning suggest specialist review.
records.rationale: Gate remarried; criteria blended_family, previous_dependants, estate_goal, beneficiary_complex; planning_focus Multiple dependants and beneficiary planning. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; blended_family and previous_dependants map to dependants.

records.name: Unmarried cohabiting partners
records.planning_complexity_reason: Separate assets, property rights and estate plans for unmarried partners suggest specialist review.
records.rationale: Gate cohabiting_unmarried; criteria separate_ownership, shared_housing, estate_goal, partner_earns; planning_focus Separate assets, property rights and estate plans. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; gate cohabiting_unmarried with partner_earns maps to couple.

records.name: Estranged individual
records.planning_complexity_reason: Retirement without expected family support raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate estranged_family; criteria no_family_support, single_household, housing_independent, emergency_contact_absent; planning_focus Retirement without expected family support. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; single_household and no_family_support map to single.

records.name: Person managing a parent's finances
records.planning_complexity_reason: Financial authority, capacity and safeguarding when managing a parent's finances suggest specialist review.
records.rationale: Gate manages_parent_finances; criteria parent_supported, authority_verified, safeguarding_needed, shared_expenses; planning_focus Financial authority, capacity and safeguarding. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; manages_parent_finances, parent_supported and safeguarding_needed map to caregiver.

records.name: Fully paid HDB owner
records.planning_complexity_reason: Housing security with a fully paid HDB flat is a standard planning situation.
records.rationale: Gate hdb_owner; criteria mortgage_paid, housing_stable, cpf_housing_use, retirement_goal; planning_focus Housing security and retirement cash flow. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; cpf_housing_use is a housing-use pattern, not a retirement-situation pattern, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies; no household predicate, so household_context is varies.

records.name: HDB owner with mortgage
records.planning_complexity_reason: Servicing an HDB mortgage alongside a retirement goal is a standard planning situation.
records.rationale: Gate hdb_owner; criteria mortgage_active, monthly_mortgage, cpf_housing_use, retirement_soon; planning_focus Debt service and retirement affordability. retirement_soon is not a tight age band, so life_stage is spans_stages; no work-type predicate, so work_income_type is not_applicable; cpf_housing_use is not a retirement-situation pattern, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Private condominium owner with mortgage
records.planning_complexity_reason: Private-property concentration with an active mortgage raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate private_condo_owner; criteria mortgage_active, property_concentrated, monthly_mortgage, income_high; planning_focus Property concentration and liabilities. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Multiple-property owner
records.planning_complexity_reason: Rental yields, vacancy and tax across multiple properties raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate multiple_properties; criteria rental_income, vacancy_risk, mortgage_active, property_concentrated; planning_focus Rental yields, taxes and vacancy. No age-band or work-type predicate, so life_stage is spans_stages and work_income_type is not_applicable; rental_income is asset income, not a work type; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Asset-rich, cash-poor senior homeowner
records.planning_complexity_reason: An asset-rich, cash-poor senior homeowner faces monetisation and liquidity difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate age_65plus; criteria property_concentrated, liquid_low, mortgage_paid, housing_monetisation_goal; planning_focus Monetisation and accessible capital. Gate age_65plus maps to payout_age_65_plus; no work-type predicate, so work_income_type is not_applicable; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Older renter
records.planning_complexity_reason: Long-term rental affordability in retirement raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate renter; criteria age_65plus, rent_expense, rent_inflation, retired_status; planning_focus Long-term rental affordability. Criteria age_65plus maps to payout_age_65_plus; retired_status maps to not_working; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies; no household predicate, so household_context is varies.

records.name: Senior living with adult children
records.planning_complexity_reason: Housing dependency on adult children and contingency planning raise difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate age_65plus; criteria living_with_adult_child, no_property_ownership, shared_expenses, housing_contingency; planning_focus Housing dependency and contingency planning. Gate age_65plus maps to payout_age_65_plus; no work-type or retired_status predicate, so work_income_type is not_applicable; living_with_adult_child maps to multi_generation.

records.name: HDB owner considering downsizing/lease buyback
records.planning_complexity_reason: Downsizing or lease buyback proceeds and scheme eligibility raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate hdb_owner; criteria housing_monetisation_goal, age_65plus, lease_details, mortgage_paid; planning_focus Housing proceeds and scheme eligibility. Criteria age_65plus maps to payout_age_65_plus; no work-type predicate, so work_income_type is not_applicable; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Early-retirement aspirant
records.planning_complexity_reason: Funding retirement before CPF payout age raises a pre-payout bridge difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate early_retirement_goal; criteria age_under_65, pre_65_bridge, investment_assets, retirement_goal; planning_focus Funding retirement before CPF payout age. age_under_65 and pre_65_bridge cover more than one life-stage band, so life_stage is spans_stages; work type is not stated, so work_income_type is not_applicable; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Financially independent early retiree
records.planning_complexity_reason: Investment withdrawal sustainability for an early retiree raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate early_retired; criteria age_under_65, investment_assets, withdrawal_income, cashflow_surplus; planning_focus Investment withdrawal sustainability. age_under_65 covers more than one life-stage band, so life_stage is spans_stages; gate early_retired maps to not_working; payout is not stated, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Pre-retiree with savings shortfall
records.planning_complexity_reason: A retirement funding-gap with low CPF and low liquidity raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate retirement_shortfall; criteria retirement_soon, cpf_low, liquid_low, essential_expenses; planning_focus Retirement funding-gap closure. retirement_soon is not a tight age band, so life_stage is spans_stages; work type is not stated, so work_income_type is not_applicable; cpf_low maps to limited_or_no_cpf as a pattern, not an entitlement.

records.name: Worker retiring at age 60
records.planning_complexity_reason: A pre-payout income bridge after stopping work at the stated retirement age raises difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate retire_at_60; criteria age_60plus, pre_65_bridge, income_interrupted, cpf_payout_deferred; planning_focus Pre-65 income bridge. Gate retire_at_60 with age_60plus and pre_65_bridge maps to near_retirement_55_64; income_interrupted maps to not_working; cpf_payout_deferred maps to payout_deferred; no household predicate, so household_context is varies.

records.name: Retiree commencing CPF LIFE
records.planning_complexity_reason: CPF LIFE payout choices and household income at commencement raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate cpf_life_starting; criteria age_65plus, ra_balance, cpf_income, retired_status; planning_focus Payout choices and household income. Criteria age_65plus and gate cpf_life_starting map to payout_age_65_plus; retired_status maps to not_working; cpf_life_starting with cpf_income maps to payout_started as a pattern, not an entitlement.

records.name: Retiree considering CPF payout deferral
records.planning_complexity_reason: An income bridge while considering payout deferral raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate cpf_payout_deferred; criteria age_65plus, pre_65_bridge, liquid_assets, cashflow_surplus; planning_focus Income bridge and payout trade-offs. Criteria age_65plus maps to payout_age_65_plus; the name is a retiree with no work predicate, so work_income_type is not_working; gate cpf_payout_deferred maps to payout_deferred.

records.name: Semi-retired professional
records.planning_complexity_reason: Part-time consulting combined with staged withdrawals raises planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate semi_retired; criteria parttime_work, consulting_income, withdrawal_income, age_65plus; planning_focus Part-time earnings and staged withdrawals. Criteria age_65plus maps to payout_age_65_plus; parttime_work and consulting_income plus withdrawal_income map to mixed; no CPF-retirement predicate, so cpf_retirement_situation is varies.

records.name: Retiree aged 80+
records.planning_complexity_reason: Longevity and ongoing care expenditure in later retirement raise planning difficulty.
records.rationale: Gate age_80plus; criteria retired_status, care_expenses, cpf_income, liquid_assets; planning_focus Longevity and ongoing care expenditure. Gate age_80plus maps to payout_age_65_plus; retired_status maps to not_working; cpf_income with retired_status maps to payout_started as a pattern, not an entitlement.

records.name: High earner with low savings
